description: Will this Hugging Face repo run on this hardware? Checks the repo and its quantized derivatives (GGUF/MLX/AWQ...) and returns, per candidate: verdict (fits | fits-tight | offload | no | unknown), memory placement (VRAM / RAM / SSD), longest context that fits, decode and prefill tok/s bands with basis, concurrent-serving aggregate, runtime support (llama.cpp / vLLM / MLX registries) and an exact launch command. repo: 'org/name' (base model or a GGUF repo). hardware: preset id, '<N>x-<id>', free text, or 'gpu=..,ram=..,bw=..'. ctx in tokens.
name: estimate_fit
title: Estimate model fit and speed
